479:t_1:3.en: ～ Inside the Imperial Capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$ ～

479:t_1:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「...That's the data $$ダバラーン$$ gathered. What do you make of it, $$アウストラリス$$?」

479:t_1:5.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I find it hard to believe...」

479:t_1:7.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Why were people who have reached this level left unchecked...?」

479:t_1:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Well, considering who has jurisdiction over this universe, it's no surprise. Especially with that dimensional cage in place.」

479:t_1:9.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「What are you talking about?」

479:t_1:10.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It does not concern you yet.」

479:t_1:11.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're hard on newcomers, Your Majesty. So I'm still a novice until I steal the $$いがみ合う双子$$?」

479:t_1:12.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「If you understand that, I have nothing more to say.」

479:t_1:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「No, $$アムブリエル$$. It's my turn to sortie next.」

479:t_1:15.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「So I stay behind?」

479:t_1:16.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Don't sulk. Your factor is every bit as strong as $n's.」

479:t_1:17.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Once you steal that $$ジェミニオン$$, you should reach the Third Stage in no time.」

479:t_1:18.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「All the more reason to go. Otherwise His Imperial Majesty will never acknowledge me.」

479:t_1:19.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...I forbid you to sortie.」

479:t_1:21.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I am giving $$エルーナルーナ$$ a special mission. Do not interfere.」

479:t_1:22.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's $$アウストラリス$$ for you. You understand how I work.」

479:t_1:23.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「There you have it, $$アムブリエル$$. Your boy hunt will have to wait.」

479:t_1:25.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Oh dear... Now she's sulking.」

479:t_1:26.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Without that much spirit, one has no right to a seat here.」

479:t_1:27.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Then all of $c's $$リアクター$$s qualify. Including $n.」

479:t_1:28.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Yes... That man is approaching the Third Stage.」

479:t_1:29.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Heh... Who knew we'd find someone who could awaken the $$いがみ合う双子$$? Two of them, at that.」

479:t_1:30.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It is probably due to the peculiar nature of this planet called Earth.」

479:t_1:31.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Maybe... I've conquered countless planets, but I've never seen one like this.」

479:t_1:32.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Even I'm starting to wonder how to crush the spirits of the people on this planet.」

479:t_1:33.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Is it because $$オリジン・ロー$$ gathers here...? Or does $$オリジン・ロー$$ gather here because of that...?」

479:t_1:34.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I don't care. I just want to accomplish my goal and move on to the next stage.」

479:t_1:36.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I know. I'll carry out the mission.」

479:t_1:37.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...The power within this planet's people is gradually taking shape...」

479:t_1:38.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Thanks to $c running around everywhere, cracks are opening in our front lines. At this rate, the tide could turn.」

479:t_1:39.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「We must stop the evolution of this planet's people. Striking at its starting point should be effective.」

479:t_1:40.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「The blood of the beast... That one's quite my type.」

479:t_1:41.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I leave the operation to you.」

479:t_1:42.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I don't need a plan. When beasts fight, it's kill or be killed.」

479:t_1:49.en:
$$葵$$
「That brings my simulation record to seven wins and three losses.」

479:t_1:52.en:
$n
「I'm not wasting this chance. You hardly ever agree to be my simulation opponent.」

479:t_1:53.en:
$$葵$$
「OK. I'll go as long as you want today.」

479:t_1:54.en:
$$タケル$$
「Hold on, $$葵$$, $n. You've done way too many rounds in a row.」

479:t_1:55.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Please take a little break. We have drinks, too.」

479:t_1:56.en:
$$葵$$
「How sweet of you, $$シンジ$$ and $$タケル$$.」

479:t_1:58.en:
$$葵$$
「Hehe... Thanks. ...Or do you have some ulterior motive?」

479:t_1:60.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's enough teasing, $$葵$$. You're scaring $$シンジ$$.」

479:t_1:61.en:
$$葵$$
「Then will you keep me company, $$タケル$$?」

479:t_1:66.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Do you know why $$葵$$ is acting strange?」

479:t_1:68.en:
$n
「Well... Um... I used to be a beast hunter, so... I know... a fair bit... about animal behavior...」

479:t_1:69.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Is this any time to introduce yourself?!」

479:t_1:79.en:
$$葵$$
「You don't have to be so scared. I'm not going to gobble you up while Miss $$スズネ$$ is away.」

479:t_1:83.en:
$$葵$$
「You don't need to apologize. ...You're probably right.」

479:t_1:85.en:
$$葵$$
「So keep me company. You'll be my simulation opponent until this fire in my blood dies down.」
